ValidationRule.description: Blocks sending a Binding quote (Status to Presented) while Finance Approval Phase is not Approved/Not_Required. Closes the gap where binding quotes reached the customer before Finance sign-off. Complements VR_QUOTE_02 (Accept gate).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Presented"), Is_Binding__c = true, NOT(ISBLANK(Finance_Approval_Phase__c)), Finance_Approval_Phase__c <> "Approved", Finance_Approval_Phase__c <> "Not_Required" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This is a Binding quote and Finance has not approved it yet. A Binding quote can only be sent to the customer once Finance Approval is Approved (or Not Required). Please complete Finance review first.
